name: PrintStash
short_desc: Self-hosted library for 3D models and the G-code that prints them
description: PrintStash keeps your 3D models, sliced G-code revisions and print history in one searchable library on your own server. Preview STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP and G-code in the browser, keep the revisions that printed well, index existing NAS folders in place, and send prints to Klipper/Moonraker, OctoPrint, PrusaLink, Bambu Lab and Elegoo printers.
author: PrintStash contributors

form_fields.label: Administrator username
form_fields.hint: Created on first start. Sign in with it, then choose where PrintStash stores files.

form_fields.label: Administrator password
form_fields.hint: At least 8 characters. Used once; to change it later, reset it under Settings → Users.
